The Montrose

Steps from everywhere you want to be.

Montrose at Buffalo Bayou sits inside one of Houston's most walkable, art-filled neighborhoods — close to green space, world-class institutions, and the city's best tables.

≈ 0.3 mi

Buffalo Bayou Park

Houston's flagship green space, right across Allen Parkway — hike-and-bike trails, kayak launches, and the Waterworks & Cistern art space, all an easy morning walk away.

≈ 4.5 mi

The Galleria

Texas's largest shopping center — Nordstrom, Neiman Marcus, an indoor ice rink, and hundreds of shops and restaurants under one roof.

≈ 3 mi

Rice University

One of the nation's top-ranked research universities, with a historic, tree-lined campus and the Rice Village shops just beyond its gates.

≈ 4 mi

Texas Medical Center

The largest medical complex in the world — more than 60 member institutions, hospitals, and research centers in one campus.

≈ 2.5 mi

Downtown Houston

The city's skyline, theater district, and venues like Minute Maid Park and Toyota Center — a short drive or rideshare from Montrose.

≈ 2 mi

Upper Kirby

A walkable strip of local restaurants, boutiques, and coffee shops just south of the park — a favorite for weekend brunch.

Distances are approximate, straight-line estimates from the community.

Questions, Answered

What renters ask most.

Straight answers, so you know exactly what to expect before you tour.

Does it cost anything to use Brittany Rose as a leasing agent?

No. Brittany's fee is paid by the apartment community, not the renter. Touring, applying, and leasing through Brittany costs exactly the same as leasing directly — but with someone handling the process on your behalf.

What floor plans does Montrose at Buffalo Bayou offer?

Studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom floor plans. Current pricing and availability change daily, so Brittany pulls today's rate when you reach out rather than posting numbers that go stale.

Is Montrose at Buffalo Bayou pet friendly?

Yes — cats and dogs are welcome upon approval. Breed restrictions apply, along with a non-refundable pet fee and monthly pet rent.

Do I have to enter a contest to get the 65″ TV?

No — it's not a sweepstakes or a drawing. Sign any executed lease at Montrose at Buffalo Bayou through Brittany and she gives you a 65″ TV directly as a closing gift, guaranteed, while supplies last.

Where is Montrose at Buffalo Bayou located?

1320 Montrose Blvd, Houston, TX 77019 — inside the Montrose neighborhood and steps from Buffalo Bayou Park, with easy access to The Galleria, Rice University, Texas Medical Center, downtown Houston, and Upper Kirby.
